cohort: Women with a history of anal sphincter rupture
finding: Women with a past history of anal sphincter rupture have an 8% risk of recurrence, and anal incontinence affects half of the women with recurrent anal sphincter rupture, with no significant difference in anal incontinence rates between women with recurrent rupture, those with subsequent uncomplicated vaginal delivery, or those who delivered by Cesarean section.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the occurrence of anal incontinence between women with recurrent anal sphincter rupture and those who delivered vaginally without repeat rupture or by Cesarean section.
